documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.summary: Pilot-only scope and on-the-fly BM25/raw verification during search
documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.details: search_pilot rebuilds passage and whole-case BM25 in memory over the 916 selected pilot cases and verifies all 1,024 Qdrant points on each CLI call (~66-67s local wall time per search vs ~0.06-0.10s remote GPU query embedding). This is intentional and safe for the 1,024-passage pilot, but full-corpus indexing (415,693 passages / 7,708 cases) will require persistent lexical indexing and non-exhaustive per-query DB health checks.

documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.summary: Fixed batching padding overhead on ungrouped passage order
documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.details: Batching 1,024 passages in deterministic manifest passage_id order (batch_size=16) consumed 132,843 real input tokens and 338,528 padded tokens (205,685 padding tokens, ~2.55x padded/input ratio). Length-bucketing before batching could reduce padding compute in full-corpus runs if singleton-vs-batch cosine tolerance remains within 0.001.

documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.summary: Operational pilot PASS does not certify retrieval quality, legal semantics, or M4 agent delivery
documented_limits_and_non_blocking_obser.details: Labels/gold were never accessed (labels_accessed=false, test_sources_accessed=false). Context opening via m3 open is strictly diagnostic (diagnostic_only=true, M4_delivery_recorded=false). COLIEE Task 1 F1, speaker/holding ownership semantics, and full-corpus readiness remain outside M3 pilot scope.
